message.content:
Factor \(198\):

\[
198 = 2 \times 3^2 \times 11
\]

The sum of all positive divisors of \(198\) is:

\[
(1+2)(1+3+3^2)(1+11)
\]

\[
= 3 \times (1+3+9) \times 12
\]

\[
= 3 \times 13 \times 12 = 468
\]

To find the sum of the proper divisors, subtract \(198\) itself:

\[
468 - 198 = 270
\]

The answer is 270.
